description:
Hello! I'm Pedro Frederico Silva, but you can call me Fred.

I'm a Backend and Systems Engineer with 8 years of experience building scalable distributed systems, internal platforms, and developer tooling in high-scale production environments. Currently working at Euronext Securities, I focus on developing mission-critical, event-driven services using Java, Kafka, and cloud-native architectures, with a strong emphasis on reliability, observability, and engineering productivity.

I've always been passionate about technology, maps, and gaming. My curiosity and desire to keep learning led me from topography and geospatial engineering into software development, a journey shaped by different academic experiences, continuous learning, and a drive to take on new challenges.

Beyond writing code, I'm interested in designing reliable systems, improving development workflows, and building tools that help engineering teams deliver software more efficiently. I enjoy exploring new technologies, sharing knowledge, and continuously expanding my skills.

I created this portfolio using React to showcase some of the projects I've worked on, highlight my professional journey, and share more about my interests and the things I'm passionate about.

As a Portuguese citizen, I'm authorized to work across all European Union member states. I'm also pursuing opportunities in Canada through the IEC Working Holiday program and am open to relocating to Canada for on-site, hybrid, or remote positions, as well as exploring international opportunities in backend engineering, platform engineering, and developer tooling.

Thanks for stopping by! I hope you enjoy exploring my work.
